title: A carried test's end taken during the running turn is dropped from that turn's transcript, and no test pins the transcript outcome
outcome: The transcript outcome is decided and pinned when a carried Codex test's end arrives with no turn id or tagged with the running turn and the Engram host takes it: either the end stays out of the running turn's transcript, as now, or it also reaches the recorder (handle_codex_app_server_item_completed) after the host took it. A test asserts the chosen transcript outcome.
acceptance: A test delivers a carried test's end with no turn id and one tagged with the running turn, and asserts the chosen transcript outcome as well as the carried check's end.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
